anime.synopsis: The special is confined to the wedding of Prince Akishino with his chosen Kiko Kawashima.

anime.title: Sora Tobu Usagi no Yuukai Boushi: Boku Iya da yo!
anime.synopsis: An educational anime designed to prevent child abduction.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Minami no Umi wo Sukue!
Osomatsu-kun: Iyami wa Hitori Kaze no Naka
anime.synopsis: A ronin Iyami falls in love with a blind girl in this period romantic comedy adapting Charlie Chaplin's City Lights film.

anime.title: Watashi no Ashinaga Oji-san Pilot Film
anime.synopsis: Pilot film that was included in VHS volume 1 of Watashi no Ashinaga Oji-san.

anime.title: Pokopon no Yukai na Saiyuuki
anime.synopsis: Pokopon starring in an animated version of Journey to the West. Note: Part of the "Sanrio Anime Festival" series of theatrical releases.

anime.title: Onimaru: Senjou ni Kakeru Itsutsu no Seishun
Chie the Brat: The Travails of Chie
anime.synopsis: An adaptation of the first series, with different characters and an alternate setting.

anime.title: Jingi
anime.synopsis: The series centers around Jin, a hitman, and Yoshiro, a former far-left terrorist, who meet by chance and together rise through the ranks of yakuza society.

anime.title: Ushiro no Hyakutarou
anime.synopsis: Horror OVA based on the manga by Jirou Tsunoda. The title roughly means "Hyakutarou behind". A boy named Ichitarou Ushiro deals with various horrifying phenomena with the help of his guardian spirit Hyakutarou. 2 episodes: "Kokkuri Satsujin Jiken", "Yuutai Ridatsu". (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Ucchare Goshogawara
anime.synopsis: Musashi Mountain High School third grade Goshogawara is the only member of his school's sumo club. In order to take part in competitions, he tries to attract more members, and thanks to his enthusiasm and sincerity four more people join the club: judo team captain Kaoru Kiyokawa; pro wrestler Takayuki Kannai; skinny thug wannabe Nanno Ippei; and Raiden Goro, a giant guy but a very shy person who also happens to be an expert Go player. The five train together and later take part in a competition against a professional sumo club.

anime.title: Miracle Psychicer Seizan
anime.synopsis: Takeru Aoyama, a young man, continues his journey in search of the Three Sacred Treasures in order to save humanity, bravely contending against the Chimimouryou (evil spirits of the mountains and rivers in the mythical Japanese bestiary).

anime.title: Juudou-bu Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Based on the same name manga by Kobayashi Makoto.

anime.title: Taabou no Ryuuguusei Daitanken
anime.synopsis: Space Adventure version of Urashima Tarou's fairy tale. Note: Part of the "Sanrio Anime Festival" series of theatrical releases.

anime.title: Ishii Hisaichi no Dai Seikai
anime.synopsis: Based the same name gag manga by Hisaichi Ishii.

anime.title: Marude Dameo
anime.synopsis: The series stars an elementary school boy named Dameo Marude, who has little success with anything he tries, and a robot named Borot, which is good with housekeeping. Based on the same name manga by Morita Kenji, serialized in Weekly Shounen Magazine.

anime.title: Huckleberry no Bouken (Movie)
anime.synopsis: Movie version of the TV series Huckleberry no Bouken.

anime.title: OH! MY Konbu
anime.synopsis: Fifth-grader Nabeyama Konbu is the son of a cook in a slice-of-life gourmet comedy that tries to add an element of adventure to slaving in the kitchen. Konbu helps his father solve problems in the world through the judicious use of seasonings, the right choice of menu, and the pleasing of fickle customers. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Kumo ni Noru
anime.synopsis: In a Buddhist heaven where saints fight over turf in the clouds, Nio-maru searches for the younger sister torn from him in an aircraft accident back in the human world. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

anime.title: Bakabon Osomatsu no Curry wo Tazunete Sanzenri
anime.synopsis: Bakabon's dad's journey in search of a delicious curry.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Dokin-chan no Dokidoki Calendar
anime.synopsis: Dokin-chan is finally the star of the show, watch as they sing and dance on the big stage! Baikinman joins in on the fun of the variety show, and the two look back on Soreike! Anpanman's past episodes.

anime.title: Kobo-chan Special: Yume Ippai!!
anime.synopsis: Kobo Tabata lives in a typical Japanese family. His father is a normal salary-man, his mother's a typical housewife, his grandparents (from his mother's side) help to take care of the family and it's pets, and his uncle's a slightly obese high school teacher. Still, they manage to find odd situations that sometimes arise due to Kobo's growing up process or simply because of their own habits and misunderstandings.

anime.title: Fox Wood Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Based on: "Foxwood Tales" (picture book series) by Cynthia & Brian Paterson.

anime.title: Chibi Maruko-chan Special
anime.synopsis: Special episode of the first Chibi Maruko-chan series.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Sanjuushi
anime.synopsis: Keroppi starring in an animated version of The Three Musketeers. Note: Part of the "Sanrio Anime Festival" series of theatrical releases.

anime.title: Shounen Ashibe
anime.synopsis: After moving to a new town, a young boy comes across a lone baby seal. They become fast friends and enjoy everyday life together.

anime.title: MY CROSSROAD
anime.synopsis: Chieko dreaming of being tomorrow's star, is an absent-minded and careless person, but has stronger passion than anybody else. Today as everyday, she's doing her best to get the role of heroine in the graduation play. A sweet, sweet story with a comical touch.

anime.title: Chirorin Village Story
anime.synopsis: Nutsberry Town is a beautiful small country town, surrounded by shimmering lakes, lush forests and green fields. It's a place where old-fashioned values still abound. It is here that our heroes, Snappy the Onion, Wendy the Walnut and Pee Wee the Peanut, a madcap trio known as the "Kooky Kids" play their mischievous games. Never mean-spirited or malicious, the Kooky Kids still manage to get into trouble in their non-stop quest for fun and adventure. And because Nutsberry Town is far from the hustle and bustle of video arcades, shopping malls or theme parks, the children find their fun amidst their beautiful surroundings and in their imagination. (Source: enokifilmsusa.com)

anime.title: Patchin shite! Obaa-chan
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in Kanazawa and tells the story of Yasue, an old woman who suddenly became very ill, her whole body paralyzed. She is told by her doctor she only has two weeks to live...

anime.title: Naniwa Yuukyouden
anime.synopsis: Taido Kaimon is the leader of the Kinshu Group ganster syndicate in Kansai region. His gang is a cluster of wisecracking madmen, eternally running into trouble with the law, each other, and the local girls who give as good as they get. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

anime.title: Do it Kororin Earth SOS
anime.synopsis: Jiang came to the old family cherry blossom viewing venue. But the surrounding area was full of garbage. He sits there to eat lunch reluctantly when a strange creature falls from the sky! Kororin is his name. He comes from the Star Oasis and is here to teach the importance of environmental consciousness with his ESP. Jiang, his sister, and Kororin must battle Syndrome, the evil alien plotting the destruction of the Earth. The attempted destruction is usually through some environmental issue such as tearing a hole in the ozone, or changing the weather, or overuse of electricity, etc.

anime.title: Nontan to Issho
anime.synopsis: Nontan is the protagonist of a Japanese series of children's picture books by the same name written by Sachiko Kiyono. In the series, Nontan is a mischievous kitten who likes to play and learns about the world around him. Other characters include Pig, Rabbit triplet, Raccoon, Bear, Bee, and Nontan's little sister Taatan. (Source: Wikipedia)

anime.title: Don: Gokudou Suikoden
anime.synopsis: Based on the manga of the same name by Motomiya Hiroshi.

anime.title: Gekikara Gag Gekijou: Tabasco Shower
anime.synopsis: Based on the yonkoma manga by Iwatani Tenho.

anime.title: Senbon Matsubara: Kawa to Ikiru Shounen-tachi
anime.synopsis: After suffering severe floods in 1753, the people of Senbon Matsubara in Shizuoka cooperate on flood prevention around the Kiso, Nagara, and Yuhi rivers. The people of Satsuma (Kumamoto Prefecture) endure great hardships after being forced to undertake the work by the central government, a subtle indication of the bad feeling that would foment into open rebellion the following century. (Source: AnimeVice)

anime.title: Zoku Naniwa Yuukyouden
anime.synopsis: The Kinshu Group is back to their old antics in this mob comedy. Two new recruits join the gang and try to prove their worth. Things take a turn for the worse with the boss takes a bullet and is hospital ridden. What will happen to the gang as snakes begin to creep to break apart company as if the boss is dead?! *Based on the same name manga by Dookuman Pro, a group of four manga artists.

anime.title: Naniwa Yuukyouden: Nekketsu!! Bakushou Mankai-hen
anime.synopsis: In the 3rd series continues as the gang hits up a karaoke bar at night only to cause a ruckus with their less than desirable signing. They soon find out the karaoke bar might close from local hooligans and attempt to rescue it for compensation. A fellow gang member gets involved too deep with a woman--even though he's married.

anime.title: TWO ON THE ROAD: Itsumo Futari de
anime.synopsis: Two anthology releases of 13 short stories, based on originals by Seizo Watase. As with other adaptations of Watase's work, they are set to music-stories here include: Ashes of Love, White Fish/Blue Fish, Dance on the Sands, Glider, Handbag Mirror, Blue Snow, Living in the World, etc. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

anime.title: Little Twins: Bokura no Natsu ga Tondeiku
Sasurai-kun
anime.synopsis: Sasurai is a hapless, overworked and existentially lonely salaryman with a crush on his attractive co-worker simply because she’s considerate of him and is the attractive woman he sees every day. Note: The first episode aired with a run-time of ~15 minutes as opposed to the standard 10-minute-long episode.

anime.title: Youkai Ningen Bem: Part II
anime.synopsis: For 1982 a 26-episode TV series sequel to Youkai Ningen Bem was planned. Because the original producers disbanded, the animation was done by Topcraft. 2 episodes were created and the project shut down without airing on television. The episodes were released to the public on a LD-Box Set a decade later. 2,000 units were printed and all were sold out.

anime.title: Shika to Kanta
anime.synopsis: One day, Kanta, a lonely boy, rescues an orphaned baby sika deer and names it Poyu. There is something special about Poyu, his golden tail. When hunters go after Poyu, Kanta is determined to protect his golden-tailed friend and the other deer. (Source: myanimelist) Adapted from a children's novel with the same name, written by Daisaku Ikeda and illustrated by Sho Murakami. It tells the sad history of overhunting of sika deer by humans, as well as the friendship between sika deer and children.

anime.title: Shou-chan Sora wo Tobu
anime.synopsis: An anime version of Ikkei Makina's horror novel of the same name. It aired at the same time as the live-action adaptation. (Source: aniDB)

anime.title: Maboroshi Mabo-chan
anime.synopsis: Mabo-chan goes on a world-wide journey to find a cure after his parents were turned to stone after eating an apple infected with a mysterious bacteria.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Ganbare! Keroppiis
anime.synopsis: Kerropi and his friends are hectored when they have fun in the playground. Both of them agree to have a baseball competition. During the exercise, Junk quits the team because of their argument. Will they lose finally?

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Kyouryuu ga Deta
anime.synopsis: While playing hide and seek, Keroppi and the gang find some dinosaur bones. With the village elder they dig out more and put the bones back together and find out it was a baby dinosaur. In the nearby museum there is a mama dinosaur on display and as night falls the baby dinosaur's skeleton comes to life in search of its mother. The gang tries to help it reunite it and the cries of the baby dinosaur skeleton animate the mama's skeleton. Once together again their souls ascend to heaven and both skeletons become displayed lovingly at the museum.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Sora Tobu Yume no Fune
anime.synopsis: Keroppi and friends get special tickets to ride a flying ship at night to look at the constellations. Whether they dreamt the same dream or encountered it for real is up interpretation.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Tomodachitte Ii na
anime.synopsis: A new kid moves to town for a short stay with his father. He's really good at playing the ocarina but difficult to befriend. A bird likes to listen to his music and when a storm arrives they all help the bird by placing it and its nest into a bird house; this helps them all form an everlasting friendship as he moves once again.

anime.title: Kappa no Sanpei
anime.synopsis: Sanpei is a lazy little 7 year old boy who rarely concentrates on anything beside eating his school dinners. Despite being constantly jeered at by his classmates for looking like a Kappa, Sanpei is a relatively happy go lucky boy that is quite content with living alone with his grandfather in the mountains. One day, Sanpei's school announces that it will hold a swimming gala with the top prize being an all expenses paid trip to the big city of Tokyo. Sanpei resolves to enter the contest so that he can have the chance to visit Tokyo and meet with his Mother who seems to have been working there for as long as he can remember. Unfortunately, Sanpei is not a very able swimmer and so decides to sneak off to a nearby lake to practice in secret. Sanpei quickly finds himself dragged under the water by a strong undercurrent and drowns only to find himself regain consciousness within the magical realm of the Kappa. Thus begins Sanpei's journey as he befriends one of the Kappa children, Gartaro, and begins to learn the real whereabouts of his Mother and the reason behind his Fathers disappearance...

anime.title: Tsuyoshi Shikkari Shinasai: Tsuyoshi no Time Machine de Shikkari Shinasai
anime.synopsis: Tsuyoshi Shikkari Shinasai movie.

anime.title: Naniwa Kinyuu Den: Minami no Teiou
anime.synopsis: The story centers around Ginjirou Manda, a loan shark who charges toichi — 10% more interest every 10 days, or 365% every year. Thanks to his unrelenting money-collecting tactics, he is feared as Minami no Oni or the Demon of Osaka's Minami business district.

anime.title: Naniwa Yuukyouden: Chou Gokudou! Yoru no Bat wa Manrui-hen
Naniwa Yuukyouden: Kyouretsu! Ana ga Attara Iretai-hen
Sanrio Sekai Meisaku Eigakan

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Mitsubachi Daisoudou
Kero Kero Keroppi no Tomodachi wa Mahou Tsukai
anime.synopsis: The story begins when Arcana, who is practicing magic, visits Keroppi. Keroppi's friends are surprised by the magic of Arcana, but that night the birthday present for Kerorinu disappears. Who stole the present?

anime.title: 3 Choume no Tama: Uchi no Tama Shirimasen ka?
anime.synopsis: The first season of 3 Choume no Tama: Uchi no Tama Shirimasenka? Note: The 1993 TV series is a recut of the 7-episode OVA series 'Tama & Friends: 3 Choume Monogatari' omitting the first OVA, but adding 3 additional new episodes.

anime.title: Pochacco in Exciting Birthday
anime.synopsis: It's the day before Pochacco's birthday and he's skateboarding around looking for his friends. He hopes to have a grand party with them the next day, but they all seem busy!

anime.title: Sam to Chip no Hachamecha Dai Race
anime.synopsis: The Hari Hari Island Adventure Rally is just about to start! Hello Kitty, Mimmy, Little Twin Stars, Keroppi, and other Sanrio favorites have gathered in fantastical cars for an endurance race around the island’s many obstacles. Tuxedo Sam and Chip think their vehicle has what it takes to win the checkered flag, but after a late start and a few unfortunate accidents, can this plucky duo survive the odds and pull off a victory? (Source: Sanrio Wiki) Note: Released for VHS alongside "Kero Kero Keroppi no Daibouken: Fushigi na Mame no Ki (けろけろけろっぴの大冒険 ふしぎな豆の木)"

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Kero Kero House no Himitsu
anime.synopsis: On a rainy day Keroppi and friends find their elders' old secret club house. But the house ends up being more magical than they thought.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Yowamushi-ouji no Daibouken
anime.synopsis: Keroppi is blamed for the tomfoolery of others during a movie. As he runs home crying he is struck by lightening and transported to another world--just like in the movie! There he meets a cowardly prince and the both of them go on adventure to learn about courage and sticking up for oneself.

anime.title: Eddy & Emmy no Initial Ring wa Futari de
anime.synopsis: As Eddy and Emmy's birthday is coming up, the two friends find themselves faced with dilemmas that threaten to put a damper on the special occasion; Emmy is chosen to perform with Cal, one of the most popular boys for the school festival and is busy with the auditions that come with it, while Eddy feels left out in all of the excitement. Will they find a way to pull through, or will the duo be forced to also give up their prized rings in the process?

anime.title: Mary Bell no Koutsuu Anzen
anime.synopsis: A traffic safety short starring the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell cast. The short was re-released on the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell DVD-Box Set in 2009.

anime.title: Mary Bell no Hi no Youjin: Guratto Kitara Dousuru
anime.synopsis: A fire safety short starring the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell cast. It specifically focuses on fires that start because of an earthquake and what a child should do in such a situation when they may be trapped in a building. The short was re-released on the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell DVD-Box Set in 2009.

anime.title: Terajimachou Kidan: Ginnagashi
anime.synopsis: Ten-year-old Kyoshi watches as a tramp transforms himself into a rich imposter at a stand-up bar in the Tamanoi district. Amusing tales from pre-war Tokyo based on the 1968 autobiographical manga Strange Tales of Terajima, written by Yuu Takita for the alternative magazine Garo. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia, edited)

anime.title: Heisei Inu Monogatari Bow: Genshi Inu Monogatari Bow
anime.synopsis: The story is set in primitive times,in a village which is home to Bow, Sayaka, and other funny characters. The village is suffering from a shortage of food. To resolve this critical situation, Inugami’s grandmother makes a prophesy: “The chosen one will save the village with a great animal.” Following this prophesy, Bow, Sayaka, Inugami, and Sabu set out together on a journey. Sayaka expends great effort trying to capture a mammoth, while Bow causes confusion by fooling around in his usual way… (Source: Nipponanimation)

anime.title: Dohyou no Oni-tachi
anime.synopsis: Animated film about the life of the 45th Yokozuna, Wakanohana Kanji I.

anime.title: Terrifying Kyou-chan
anime.synopsis: A parody of "Obake no Q-taro" written by the comedian Hitoshi Matsumoto, the series is about a kid and his ugly critter (with a strange likeness with Butthead). You better not hurt the kid or Kyou-chan will grow arms on his head and feet on his mouth to rip off your guts!

anime.title: Kibun wa Uaa Jitsuzai OL Kouza
anime.synopsis: Follows an office lady who expresses the phrase "Uaa" when in a state of emotional disbelief in situations above her head—which is quite frequent in the office, while dating, and when out on the town with friends.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Lyrical☆Magical Mahou no Gakkou
Shura ga Yuku
anime.synopsis: Based on a Yakuza drama manga by Kawabe Yuu and Yamaguchi Masato.

anime.title: Kuni-chan no Ikka Ranran
anime.synopsis: A short animation based on Kuniko Yamada's semi-autobiographical essay Ikka Ranran (一家ランラン), published in 1993. It released in theaters as part of Kin-chan no Cinema Jack (欽ちゃんのシネマジャック). Yamada narrated the film herself.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Minna Atsumare! Anpanman World
anime.synopsis: Baikinman turns Anpanman and friends into babies by using the red water from a mysterious fountain that turns anyone who touches it into a baby. Some sources list the movie having 3 episodes that total of 30min

anime.title: Ningyou Rekishi Spectacle Heike Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Puppetmation of the classic Heike monogatari adaptation of Shin Heike Monogatari by Yoshikawa Eiji, produced by NHK with puppets by Kawamoto Kihachirou. Note: Internally divided into five parts – Erudition (青雲, episodes 1-12), Glory (栄華, episodes 13-24), Rebellion (乱, episodes 25-36), Continuous Change (流転, episodes 37-48 and S1) and Uncertainty (無常, episodes 49-56).

anime.title: Kobo-chan Special: Matsuri ga Ippai!
anime.synopsis: Kobo-chan televised specials that aired after the TV anime's serialization. The special is composed of 4 short stories.

anime.title: J League wo 100-bai Tanoshiku Miru Houhou!!
Saitama Bousou Saizensen Flag! Shinimonogurui no Seishun!!
anime.synopsis: Based on the manga Flag! by Hotta Akio, which was serialized in Young King from 1992 to 1995. The OVA depicts the tumultuous daily lives of three boys, including Noboru, Akira and Haruo, who inherit the flag of the locally famous fugitive tribe "Moonlight".

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Sora wo Tobetara
anime.synopsis: While playing with a kite, a bird is injured during its migration. The gang seeks help from a local pilot to help the bird make its journey.

anime.title: Kero Kero Keroppi no Tomodachi ni Narou yo
anime.synopsis: Wink is a lovely snake. He is Keroppi's friend. Keroppi wants to introduce Wink to his other friends. His friends deem Wink is a dangerous animal. Will they accept him finally?

anime.title: Onigara
anime.synopsis: Long ago, there lived a young man named Yosuke in the village of Shiiba in Hyuuga. "I want enough money and possessions to live a luxurious life without having to work" Yohei abandoned his job in his impoverished village, where only barnyard millet, oxtail millet and beans could be grown. He fled into the mountains, where one night he witnessed a strange sight. A blue ogre clinging to a large cedar tree split its back, began to shed its skin and quickly transformed into a red ogre. Yosuke stole the shed skin, wore it and began committing crimes in the village. However, when he tried to take off the skin, he couldn't get it off no matter what he did... (Source: Official Website, translated)

anime.title: Bit the Cupid
anime.synopsis: Comedy about a character who shoots arrows that cause pairs of people to fall madly in love and float about in an ecstasy of emotion. (Source: AniDB) Note: Aired on the TV Tokyo program "Anime Kan" alongside another short BONOBONO.

anime.title: Kuma no Puutarou
anime.synopsis: The series depicts Puutarou's peculiar encounters with his bizarre neighbors.

anime.title: Yanbo Ninbo Tonbo
anime.synopsis: Based on (and updated from) a 1950s NHK radio drama. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Konchuu Tsurezuregusa
anime.synopsis: This animated film is comprised of five themes chosen from Tezuka Osamu's collection of essays "Essay in Idleness of Insects" in which he had compiled studies on insects. Although this collection contains mainly academic studies, it also includes records of insect observation that lead to literary conclusions with mysterious or mythical imagery. The five essays are done in different animation techniques, and each episode is followed by a scene with the boy Tezuka Osamu and a swallow-tailed butterfly called "Oomurasaki." The film depicts the boy Tezuka Osamu desperately chasing Oomurasaki with his butterfly net, together with what he saw in his dreams. This work was screened at the show "Tezuka Osamu: Images of the Past and Future". (Source: tezukaosamu.net)

anime.title: Udauda Yatteru Hima wa Nee!
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of the manga "Udauda Yatteru Hima wa Nee!" by Hideyuki Yonehara, serialized in Weekly Shounen Champion.

anime.title: Tobe! Pegasus Kokoro no Goal ni Shoot
anime.synopsis: The movie is about the soccer team Pegasus created from the visually impaired children studying in the Chiba Prefectural School for the Blind. (Source: allcinema)

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Anpanman to Happy Otanjoubi
anime.synopsis: An animated short movie about Anpanman and his friends preparing for celebrating a birthday.

anime.title: Ningen Kakumei
anime.synopsis: Based on Daisaku Ikeda's "The Human Revolution" novels.

anime.synopsis: A hero anime about three child warriors who protect Pon Payouchien and fight against an army of monsters. Note: The episodes were released in the video magazine Ponpa (ぽん・ぱ).

anime.title: Tokai no Butchy
anime.synopsis: The third original short film created for and showing at the Osamu Tezuka Memorial Museum.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Christmas da! Minna Atsumare
anime.synopsis: Christmas has come again, and Anpanman and his friends have all gathered to prepare for some kind of grand effort - but Baikinman, without even knowing the details, will do everything he can to get in the way! Released in the collection Sore Ike! Anpanman: Uta to Ohanashi - Suteki na Christmas, as a double feature with the home video release of the Anpanman TV anime's 1994 Christmas episode.

anime.title: Cutta-kun Monogatari
anime.synopsis: An anime starring Katta-kun, a real-life pelican who inhabited the Tokiwa Park in Ube. In this movie, Katta-kun befriends Sho, a little boy whose parents went off to the Middle East because of their work. When war breaks out, Sho and Katta-kun travel to the Middle East to save Sho's parents and end the war. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: The Adventures of Slaim
anime.synopsis: A short anime shown at the V Jump Festival '95. The special is based on the manga of the same name by Osamu Kaneko.

anime.title: Kyouryuu Pikora
anime.synopsis: Special animated short inspired by NHK's Minna no Uta program Pikora is a newborn baby dinosaur, but her mother is nowhere to be found. She sets off into the woods to find her.

anime.title: Wankorobee
anime.synopsis: N/A

anime.title: Shounen Santa no Daibouken
anime.synopsis: Based on L. Frank Baum' novel: The Life and Adventures of Santa Claus.

anime.title: Harimogu Harry
anime.synopsis: Story of Harley and his animal friends going to a school.

anime.title: Pipi Tobenai Hotaru
anime.synopsis: Based on the fairy tale novel series by Akimi Ozawa (小沢昭巳).

anime.synopsis: Hanabishi, an extremely violent but chivalrous delinquent, gets into fights with yakuza, other punks and sometimes the police, gaining a feared reputation that attracts a couple of admirers and antagonizes his gang-infested school`s bosses.

anime.synopsis: Note: Part of the "Sanrio Anime Festival" series of theatrical releases.

anime.synopsis: Animated movie that was released in theatres as part of the Ultraman Wonderful World (1996) triple feature, alongside Ultraman Zearth and Revive! Ultraman.

anime.synopsis: Original episode that aired as part of X'mas da yo! Doraemon & Doraemons Chou Special!! TV special.

anime.title: BONOBONO Soushuuhen
anime.synopsis: TV compilation specials aired on TV Tokyo following the end of the series, the special episodes feature a reconstruction of the original 48 episodes, as well as some new animated segments.

anime.synopsis: Comedy about a ninja penguin.

anime.synopsis: Based on a same name children's fantasy picture book by Takeshita Ryuunosuke.

anime.synopsis: A biography of Chiharu Igaya, who won a silver medal in men's slalom in Cortina d'Ampezzo Olympics in 1956, and became the first Japanese Winter Olympics medalist. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Bokura wa Hero
Spoon-hime no Swing Kitchen
anime.synopsis: An NHK toddler's anime following a Spoon Princess and other kitchen themed characters.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Uwasa no Kaipan Deka Toujou / Buchou yo! Are ga Paris no Hi da / Gekitotsu! Kami VS Ryoutsu
anime.synopsis: Three-part TV special for Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast in a 2-hour block along with episode 34 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kikansha Sensei
anime.synopsis: The story depicts the interaction between the children of the island and their teacher, Yoshioka Makotoware who is unable to speak because of a childhood accident.

anime.title: Kyuumei Senshi Nanosaver
anime.synopsis: The third show in the Virtual Trilogy, a mix of anime and live action shots. In the beginning of the 22nd century society advanced rapidly. Now even children are able to become real doctors, a task before that took two and a half decades to achieve. And nanomachines became prevalent to fight disease. Keita is a Nanosaver, a child doctor who uses the virtual world to apply life saving techniques by entering the body and treating the patients in a virtual medical station (VMS). As more and more patients are taken in, various mysterious are uncovered about them. In the second half of the anime, a small Ethanarian alien and galactic federation is introduced.

anime.title: Hanitarou Desu.
anime.synopsis: Yoshio found Hani Taro, a clay figure that appeared from the sauceboat (receptacle for curry). Hani Taro was fond of mischief but everyone is always angry with Yoshio instead.

anime.title: Nezumi-kun no Chokki
anime.synopsis: Based on a well known children's book by Yoshio Nakae with illustrations by Noriko Ueno. It features various simple stories about a mouse in his red vest and his other animal friends.

anime.title: Meiken Lassie: Yume ni Mukatte Hashire!
anime.synopsis: Unaired episode 26 of Lassie, which was instead included in the 7th and final VHS volume

anime.title: Takoyaki Capeman
anime.synopsis: In order to protect the earth from the aliens, the god of Takoyaki created the five warriors of justice, Takoyaki Mantle Man. They risk their lives for justice. Takoyaki Mantle Man has round face, and wear a white cape and octopus belt as their symbol. Red is a leader whose special attack is Pickled Ginger Clash. Green is an energetic and hasty boy whose special attack is Green Onion Nunchaku. Pink is a precocious girl whose special attack is Okaka Flash. Blue is a sweet crybaby whose special attack is Seaweed Buster. Yellow is a cheerful boy whose special attack is Tenkasu Beam. Takoyaki Mantle Man is cute and strong heroic characters, friendly to children. Their enemies are too silly to hate. It is a very lively and amusing story. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Hanasaka Tenshi Tenten-kun
anime.synopsis: A foolish clumsy angel came to the human world to help a very unlucky boy. But more accidents are then created...

anime.title: Yoshimoto Insect Stories
anime.synopsis: A children's series about the daily lives of funny insects. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Rennyo Monogatari
anime.synopsis: A dramatization based on the novel "The Story of Rennyo" by Hiroyuki Itsuki.

anime.title: Bokutachi no Peace River
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of the children's fantasy novel by Daisaku Ikeda.

anime.title: Otoko wa Tsurai yo: Torajirou Wasurenagusa
anime.synopsis: Anime adaptation of the "Otoko wa Tsurai yo (It's tough being a man)" film series by Youji Yamada. Kuruma Torajirou (or Tora-san), a traveling salesman whose sole possessions include only the contents of a small suitcase, the clothes on his back and some pocket money, wanders from town to town peddling his wares. (Source: Wikipedia)

anime.title: Only You: Viva! Cabaret Club
anime.synopsis: Based on a manga by Fujinami Toshihiko, serialized in Weekly Spa! between 1998 and 1999. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Tenohira wo Taiyou ni
anime.synopsis: Double feature with Sore Ike! Anpanman: Anpanman to Okashi na Nakama.

anime.title: Haruniwa Ie no 3 Nin-me
anime.synopsis: The Haruba family is a wonderful family of three kids. The protagonist is the youngest son of the three siblings, who is in actuality, a spirit. The story unfolds in a nostalgic background of Japan and relates the life of this incredible family. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Anpanman to Oyakusoku
Kuzuryuugawa to Shounen
anime.synopsis: An educational film about the Kuzuryuu River in Japan. It starts out in the Meiji Era where the villages along it kept getting plagued by floods. The villagers prayed for it to stop but it did nothing. A young boy who lost his childhood friend to the floods grows up into a man and decides to take matters into his own hands. He starts constructing an embankment which leads to a village-wide project which spread to other villages along the river.

anime.title: Ojii-chan no Hanabi
anime.synopsis: An educational film showing the importance of connectence between people even when you fail in certain aspects of your life.

anime.title: Kocchi Muite Miiko
anime.synopsis: The Yamada family consists of Miiko, her brother Mamoru and her parents. Both of her parents have work, so they are usually busy during the day and are outside of the house most of the time. The troubles in Yamada family are usually caused by Miiko's lazy character and her clumsiness.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Anpanman to Okashi na Nakama
anime.synopsis: Double feature with Sore Ike! Anpanman: Tenohira o Taiyou ni.

anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 77 and 78 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Dai Hard! Ryoutsu Kankichi wa Nido Shinu
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 88 and 89 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Dai Hard 2! Shijou Saitei no Kessen
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after episodes 98 and 99 of the TV series in a long block.

anime.title: Heli-Tako Puu-chan
anime.synopsis: In a southern island called the "Whale Island", a strange creature fell suddenly from the sky. It crashed into a school, and squashed the frog teacher flat! This strange creature's name was Puchan. He somehow managed to get the frog teacher back into shape, but the classmates are suspicious of this newcomer. But soon, everyone finds Puchan very fun to be with, and Puchan joins the school. Puchan encounters many happenings at the school but each time, he somehow manages to get through them with his curious ways.

anime.title: Twin Bee Paradise Tulip Kaigan Monogatari
anime.synopsis: Special of Twin Bee Paradise that was included on the DVD release.

anime.title: Kenritsu Umisora Koukou Yakyuubu-in Yamashita Tarou-kun
anime.synopsis: Based on the popular 80's baseball manga by Koseki Kouji. Tarou Yamashita loves baseball, but he was always the worst player. However, through effort and dedication he begins to shine in the Umisora High team.

anime.title: Kobo-chan Special: Yakusoku no Magic Day
anime.synopsis: Kobo-chan televised specials that aired after the TV anime's serialization. The special received some interrupted broadcasts in some parts of Japan due to an earthquake near the Miyagi Prefecture.

anime.synopsis: A special two-parts episode aired between episode 14 and 15 of Dr. Slump 2.

anime.synopsis: Double Feature with Sore Ike! Anpanman: Yuuki no Hana ga Hiraku Toki.

The anime steps away from the competitive nature of the manga and focuses on self-sufficiency and policy issues of agriculture, forestry, and fisheries in Japan in order to educate the population (as it was funded by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) using the popular franchise as a proxy.

anime.title: Seikimatsu Densetsu Wonderful Tatsunoko Land
anime.synopsis: The excessive adventure begins when a mysterious flying life-form, UBO came to "Tatsunoko Anime World Island" where all the Tatsunoko animation characters live. TV special animation program featuring all-star Tatsunoko characters. (Source: Official Website)

anime.synopsis: This collection of short stories was released along with “Crayon Shin-chan: Bakuhatsu! Onsen Wakuwaku Daikessen.”

anime.title: The Himalayan Kingdom of Light
anime.synopsis: A Nepalese boy, Surya, finds a crane with a letter requesting help. His search to find the letter’s writer takes him to a mysterious Himalayan kingdom.

anime.title: OSAMU TEZUKA ACADEMY TAISHOU
anime.synopsis: An animated special made by Tezuka Productions to celebrate the new millennium. The special contained a wide variety of different characters created by Osamu Tezuka, known as the "Star System". Characters would be given awards based on their performances throughout the years. Very little about the special has surfaced online, and it's considered completely lost.

anime.title: Chiisana Kyojin Microman: Daigekisen! Microman vs Saikyou Senshi Gorgon
Shin Gakkou no Yuurei
anime.synopsis: Following the popularity of the original omnibus OVA, this release offers 4 more stories but in animation only.

anime.title: Shitsuke How To
anime.synopsis: Educational videos aimed at children aged from 1 to 6, which uses songs and other fun activities to help children learn empathy, manners, languages, and life skills.

anime.title: Robo Crosser
anime.synopsis: A 12 year old boy who together with his unicycle robot, try to win a motorbike race.

anime.title: The Dream Machine
anime.synopsis: Satoshi Kon's fifth movie. "The title will be Yume Miru Kikai. In English, it will be The Dream Machine. On the surface, it's going to be a fantasy-adventure targeted at younger audiences. However, it will also be a film that people who have seen our films up to this point will be able to enjoy. So it will be an adventure that even older audiences can appreciate. There will be no human characters in the film; only robots. It'll be like a "road movie" for robots." (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: auto mommy
anime.synopsis: Parents who don't want to take care of their child leave parenting to the mail ordered robot "Auto Mommy" and allow their child to be raised in isolation. One day, they take a look at the monitor to check the child, and then they see the child wearing dog skin and hiding his face. This is not good, the parents think, because they can't send the child to school like this. So they make Auto Mommy peel the dog skin off the child, only to find that the child became a plant without a human face.

anime.title: Baby Felix
anime.synopsis: A young Felix the Cat and his baby pals find fun and mischief along their travels.

anime.title: Fuyu no Yoru no Ohanashi
anime.synopsis: Stop motion animation about a day in the forest with its cute inhabitants.

anime.title: Ojarumaru Yakusoku no Natsu Ojaru to Semira Movie
anime.synopsis: A short film introduces Semira, a strange boy who comes to play with Ojaru and his chums and bears a marked resemblance to a boy of the same name who spent a summer with the village elders when they were boys, long ago. (Source: AnimeVice)

anime.title: Hino Hideshi Toukaidou Yotsuya Kaidan
anime.synopsis: Based on Kaidan Yotsuya (Classic japanese ghost story).

anime.title: Clover 4/3
anime.synopsis: Studio Kaab's first work--an inspiring interactive animation. We follow the lives and turmoils of seven outcasted 17 year olds and you--the protagonist. Between the aches of being a girl who's younger than her body looks or a boy who'd rather get into fist fights than give handshakes, we found a piece of ourselves within the outcasted teens that's abnormal. Like a four leaf clover. Which are said to bring luck even though it is a mutant in the sea of three leaves. And so the curtain rises to glimpse at these four leaf Clovers--4 girls and 3 boys. (Source: Studio Kaab)

anime.title: Sudden Death
anime.synopsis: The story revolves around Koume who enters a private high school. She hears from her friend Sasuga that if she enters the tea ceremony club, she can eat snacks. They bring along their classmates Mikaeru and Momiji to join the club with her. The president of the club is 11th grader Ayame.

anime.title: Tsubu★Doll
anime.synopsis: With the stage set for 16 girls in Sagamihara, they will fulfill their dreams in a local idol story. Rather than focusing on girls aiming to become top idol, the story will show realistic girls that could exist anywhere as they devote their energy towards idol activities in Sagamihara. The Tsubu Doll members are "local idols" living in Sagamihara instead of regular idols.

anime.title: Galactic Divine Wind Jinraiger
anime.synopsis: A private organization called "GDW Project" announced that they are producing an anime which is related to the J9 anime trilogy, which aired in the early 80's. As the representative of GDW Project, Yu Yamamoto posted a message to the Facebook page, stating that the new series will have a "J9 taste" but include entirely new characters and story. The previous series each adopted a different motif: the Hissatsu Series for Braiger, the Shinsengumi for Baxingar, and Around the World in 80 Days for Sasuraiger. Similarly, Ginga Jinpuu Jinraiger will use the Chinese classic novel Water Margin as its motif. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Shishou Series
anime.synopsis: The story of the original novels revolves around a protagonist (played by Takasugi in the project) who experiences various spiritual encounters due to his upperclassman at his college's club, the "shishou" in the series title that has spiritual sensitivity. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Mirai Arise
anime.synopsis: A new original anime project by Sunrise announced at AnimeJapan 2015.

anime.title: Utakata:Overdrive
anime.synopsis: The story takes place in the fantasy world of Planet Note. Humans, who can no longer sing, pair up with members of a tribe of non-humans that can sing. These are the sound users "Otokata" and the singers "Utakata." Together they use the sounds and songs as weapons in competition. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Nidome no Jinsei wo Isekai de
anime.synopsis: When death tapped Renya Kunugi on the shoulder, he smiled and went willingly. After enjoying a nice, long life of 94 years, he was looking forward to shutting his eyes for the last time. He was, therefore, understandably upset when he woke up again in an empty space, devoid of memories, with a young girl in a tunic rambling on and on about how she's God. So, he did what any reasonable person would have done under those circumstances: he sent the girl flying with a kick to the face. It turned out that the girl was indeed God, and she was in a pinch. She urgently needed someone to do some interdimensional Resource smuggling, and Renya fit the bill. His mission: cross the boundary into another world, then chill for a few decades. God would handle the rest. To sweeten the deal, she offered him an eighteen-year-old body and a whole laundry list of ludicrously powerful skills, yet he remained hesitant. Then, she mentioned the food — an exotic world comes with exotic delicacies — and this sealed the deal. The next thing he knew, he was standing in a foreign land, younger, stronger, and more clueless than ever. Will he survive this world? And more importantly, will the world survive him? (Source: J-Novel Club) Note: Cancelled due to fan backlash on content in source material.

anime.title: AOTU Shijie 2
anime.synopsis: Second Season of AOTU Shijie

anime.title: Anime Roukyoku Kikou Shimizu no Jirochouden
anime.synopsis: A story based on Shimizu no Jirochou, an early yakuza who specialized in gambling and maritime transport. The anime is composed of 10 stories. Each story was told over 3 episodes. The particular tale is based on Hirosawa Torazo II's telling; Hirosawa is a roukyoku/naniwabushi.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Outa to Teasobi Tanoshii ne
Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Odorokimomonoki-tou no Daikessen
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after episode 160 of the TV series in a long block.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Ryou-san Saidai no Kiki! Rival wa Chakichaki Edokko
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 191 and 192 of the TV series.

anime.title: Digital Tokoro-san
anime.synopsis: CGI shorts about famous Japanese comedian George Tokoro.

anime.title: Shinsengumi
anime.synopsis: Produced for Fuji TV in 2000, the film reinterprets the story of a special samurai force - the Shinsengumi - at the end of the Edo period.

anime.title: Ginga Tetsudou 999: Glass no Clair (3D)
anime.synopsis: Remake of the Glass no Clair special, featuring a 3D stereoscopic animation based on the original work by Leiji Matsumoto. This is the second time Matsumoto's work has been made into a 3D film.

anime.title: Captain Fatz and the Seamorphs
anime.synopsis: With the ability to transcend time, Captain Fatz and comrades embarked on a journey of battle and adventure to gather the eight scattered stone pieces (namely Light, Darkness, Fire, Water, Air, Earth, Wood & Metal) which was granulated by the lord of destruction, in order to restore the chaotic world back to peace.

anime.title: Medaka no Gakkou
anime.synopsis: Medaka is a high school student. She wants to be a doctor, and she’s just transferred to Tanaka Private School on the recommendation of her parents. But she finds that his school looks a bit strange. For example, Pochi is such a smart student who always gets full marks, but he is a dog. And there are other classmates: Nekoko, a cat, who thinks of Pochi as a rival, Misa, a five-years-old girl. Of course, her home room teacher, Mr. Tanaka, is not normal. His face is ... A fish?! (Source: AnimeNfo)

anime.title: Tantei Shounen Kageman
anime.synopsis: Kageman is a boy who wants to become the best detective in the world. Each of the self-contained episode features a fun guessing game and unriddling of a case. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Gomira no Hoshi
Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Yukemuri Porori! 2001-nen - Kyoto no Tabi
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 217 and 218 of the TV series.

anime.title: The Princess of the Desert Kingdom
anime.synopsis: When the spring that supplies water to her kingdom dries up, the Princess decides to go into the desert in search of a faraway oasis that is said to exist. The Princess and her animal friends face many challenges in their journey to save the draught-stricken kingdom.

anime.title: Ranputan no Bouken
anime.synopsis: Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru". The hero, Rambutan, fights against a rival inside an old convertible launched at high speed. His opponent manages to rush him out of the vehicle and then bends over the hero’s girlfriend who desperately resists by kicking him in the face. Meanwhile, Rambutan catches up with the car running. He throws himself on his enemy and gets rid of him then kisses his girlfriend. The rival arises again, separates the two lovers and he and Rambutan fight again. The cycle resumes.

anime.title: Sakana no Sakana
anime.synopsis: Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru". A small white fish enters the frame and is eaten by a larger one, then the latter is in turn eaten by an even larger fish… At the end, only a huge white fish remains which seems to shrink in size. swimming towards the bottom of the screen. He leaves the frame and the cycle resumes.

anime.title: Ginga Tetsudou 999: Niji no Michishirube
anime.synopsis: Short movie screened at the 2001 Kitakyushu Expo-Festival held in Kitakyushu City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Japan.

anime.title: Tsuri Baka Nisshi
anime.synopsis: Hamazaki Densuke (Hama-chan) is an unavaricious white-collar worker who does not have any interest in success and self-protection. Even though he incurs the wrath of his superior and stir ill feelings from his wife, Hama-chan prefers to take things at his own stride and goes fishing. He feels that there are more important things in life than work and enjoys the simple things in life such as fishing. - From ANN

anime.title: Ki Fighter
anime.synopsis: The Grand Evil was sealed in a cave behind an energized shield. But now, thousand years have passed and he is about to regain his former power to break away free from the shield. In order to prevent this disaster, the Elders of Fantasia have to take measure to keep the radioactive power in the shield. They send out nymph warriors to find and fetch Ki-fighter cocoons hidden somewhere in the word. During the mission, the nymphs come across with TaeRang, the Ki-Fighter, our heroic kid. He turns out to be the one who has a power to defeat of the Grand Evil, TaeRang sets on his way to find other weak creatures and their villages that are endangered by the unjust evil power. TeaRang is the one wise and brave kid to set it all to justice. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Xevious
anime.synopsis: In the year 2150 A.D. space pilot Takeru and human computer Martha come across a giant ship which contains two mechanical beings called Sara and Ru Mi. They warn Takeru and Martha of the Gump, an alien race that is heading to Earth so that it can take over the planet. With only 40 mintues remaining until Earth's invasion, Takeru enters the Solvalou, a combat aircraft, and heads to the Gump's base on the planet Andoa. Based on Namco's classic 1980s videogame of the same name. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Forza! Hidemaru
anime.synopsis: A soccer anime with a cast of wacky animals in sports getup seems far out of its time in the early 21st century, but it was the year of the World Cup in Japan and South Korea, and the very young audience sees these tropes with fresh eyes. Hidemaru is a feisty fox; his friends include bunnies, dogs, horses, and a couple of hefty hippo girls. Based on a manga Hidemaru the Soccer Boy by Makoto Mizobuchi, serialized in CoroCoro Comics. (Source: AnimeVice)

anime.title: Ecchan no Sensou
anime.synopsis: Based on a children's novel by Etsuko Kishikawa.

anime.title: Ape Escape
anime.synopsis: The monkeys are up to no good again, but this time they're on the "heroes" side. Performing no good magic shows, cloning themselves with a ninja Jutsu and filling UFO catchers with themselves are just a few of the tricks they're pulling, while at the same time trying to adapt themselves to the human lifestyle.

anime.title: Gekijouban Saru Gecchu: Golden no Pipo Helmet - Ukkii Battle
anime.synopsis: One day, a strange monkey with a golden helmet drains out the insides of another monkey by kissing him. Hikaru, Spike's brother, goes out on an adventure to find this strange monkey. He soon befriends the monkeys and runs forward. But it isn't easy when every boss from the former games tries to block his path... (Source: MyAnimeList) Aired in theaters with Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Europe Oudan! Reiko Kyuushutsu Daisakusen
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 228 and 229 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Let's Go Nagasaki! Koi Shigure Truck Nee-chan
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 239 and 240 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Ryoutsu VS Ninja Gundan! Ura Edo-jou Ougon Densetsu
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 259 and 260 of the TV series.

anime.title: Aoi Triton
anime.synopsis: Pilot movie of Umi no Triton. It was produced in October 1971 for the intention of selling the series to international markets and features a more Western-style drawn Triton. The pilot was released to the public on the film version's DVD release nearly 3 decades later.

anime.title: Aterui
anime.synopsis: A pseudo-historical movie that follows a modern day elementary schooler as he's tossed back into time to observe Aterui--a real leader of the Emishi who fought against the Imperial Yamato Court.

anime.title: Seigi no Runner
anime.synopsis: Tomioka does not fail to deliver in his wild and unique take on the world. His multi-coloured animation talents take us on a whirlwind trip of old school trams with weird and wonderful characters. (Source: 25FPS Festival)

anime.title: Takolator
anime.synopsis: Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru". An octopus goes up an escalator placed in the water.

anime.title: Klonoa Heroes: Densetsu no Star Medal
Genki Genki Nontan
anime.synopsis: This 3D animated series for young children is based on the adventures of perky white kitten Non-tan. With his friends, fun-loving Tanuki, strong Bear, and the pink Rabbit triplets and his rival, Pig, he teaches children positive lessons about the beauty and wonder of life. (Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

anime.title: Gold Muscle
anime.synopsis: A story about a mad scientist named Dr. Carlo Gorgon, who created athletes fused with animal DNA to compete through different sports, and it's up to the human athletes, who were the heroes, to challenge and stop Gorgon's plan.

anime.title: Mugen Senki Portriss
anime.synopsis: In a raving world, legendary knights stood up. Will they become gods of war or world saviors? Three Portriss Knights and sole human boy are now going to change the World! Portriss Planet, home of where robots live in peace. However, this peacefulness was ruined by the sudden appearance of a Dictator "Dark Portriss". Dark Portriss plans to attain infinite powers through the use of the "Space-time destroying Cannon". The only ones able to stop this are the Portriss Knights! A boy, Yuuma, accidentally got into the Portriss World, and the Portrisses` adventure begins! (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: On-chan
anime.synopsis: On-chan and his friends from the planet Parade in space happen to meet Kenta and Haruka in the middle of a pasture, who are on their way from Tokyo to Sapporo. On-chan and his friends travel with them to help them find their new home in Sapporo, but they find many obstacles in their way. At first, Kenta is rebellious, but soon he is influenced by the power of On-chan's dreams....

anime.title: Spheres
anime.synopsis: Unbeknownst to human history, the Kingdom of Spheres existed upon our earth long ago. The people of this kingdom would be regarded today as people with psychic powers. Unfortunately, like most other civilizations, as the gap widened more and more between the social classes, the Kingdom of Spheres was troubled by those greedy for power; and in the end it collapsed. Na Yeon is a mysterious girl who was found in the Antarctic after the destruction of Spheres. One day Asten, the chairman of Sphere Union, who has a burning ambition to control the world, sent his followers to keep watch on Na Yeon. Na Yeon and her friends try to keep three artifacts, the keys to conquer the world, from the hands of Sphere Union. (Source: Wikipedia)

anime.title: Kagerouka-kun
anime.synopsis: Story of a Mayfly that falls in love with a human girl. Adapted from children's picture book by Mitsuru Nakamura aka 326.

anime.title: Kappamaki and the Sushi Kids
anime.synopsis: Kappamaki and his sushi friends are cute-cool-charming characters who soothe your grating feelings and heal your weary heart. They are all adorable characters originally made with clay by Miss Eri Okamoto. Kappamaki and the Sushi Kids are living in a small and peaceful village surrounded by unspoiled nature - flowers, fields, green forest with a crystal-clear river flowing through it. All the inhabitants including Kappamaki and his friends are naïve, honest and tenderhearted. There is a school, a park, houses, business offices and shops just like an ordinary small village anywhere. A friendly guy says that it is a typical Alpine village with the glamour of Paris and the atmosphere of Venice... Is it, really?! OK. Let's take a closer look... Oh, my goodness! The village looks as if it is made of sushi tools - The banks of the canals are sushi pails. The buildings are piled-up sushi baskets etc... This series of animated shorts is full of humorous mishaps and heart-warming tales giving smiles and chuckles to everybody. They are also educational and entertaining describing friendship and kindness. So, please enjoy the mind-healing tales in this fantasy land. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan
anime.synopsis: Grandpa Danger is a world where the great protector is Grandpa Danger! He's an expert at falling off of cliffs, dealing with a principal who suffers from a severe inferiority complex, and escaping the hidden dangers of sleep! He's a nonsensical, utterly disgusting, relentless prankster. Grandpa Danger's excessive phlegm and farts frustrate Grandson to hilarious extremes, and make you laugh until your stomach splits!

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Giboshi-ke go Ikkou-sama IN Hawaiian Dai Panic
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 270 and 271 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Sekai Number One Police Ketteisen!
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 281 and 282 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Bakusou Ressha! Abashiri-hatsu Tokyo-yuki! Ryoutsu VS Kenpou Baa-san!
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 299 and 300 of the TV series.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Kaiketsu Naganegiman to Doremi-hime
anime.synopsis: Doremifa Castle, where Princess Doremi, who loves singing and dancing, turns into a dark haunted house, Baikin Doremifa Castle, due to the evil of Baikinman and his friends!

anime.title: Mousou Kagaku Series: Wandaba Style - Mix JUICE no Tsukurikata
anime.synopsis: Mix JUICE's members are about to give a concert, they are interviewed by journalists about how the band were created. Each member gave a different story! Then, each girl sing alone but only a part of the crowd is moved. Finally they perform together and then, we learn from the producer Hanagata how he recruited the girls to give birth to Mix JUICE.

anime.title: Heart Cocktail Again: Koi no Rensa
anime.synopsis: Special episode included in the DVD for Heart Cocktail Again.

anime.title: McDull
anime.synopsis: McDull, Prince de la Bun is a 2004 animated Hong Kong film directed by Yuen Toe. Telling the life a the fictional pig McDull, it is a sequel to My Life as McDull (2001) and it was followed by McDull, the Alumni (2006). (Source: Wikipedia)

anime.title: Ton-Ton Atta to Niigata no Mukashi Banashi
Pants Pankurou
anime.synopsis: A series of minute-long animated shorts that aired on Japanese public television. Aimed at toddlers and young children, the comedic series is mostly about toilet training.

anime.title: Zettai Zetsumei Dangerous Jiisan (2004)
anime.synopsis: Grandpa Danger is a world where the great protector is Grandpa Danger! He's an expert at falling off of cliffs, dealing with a principal who suffers from a severe inferiority complex, and escaping the hidden dangers of sleep! He's a nonsensical, utterly disgusting, relentless prankster. Grandpa Danger's excessive phlegm and farts frustrate Grandson to hilarious extremes, and make you laugh until your stomach splits! (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Morizo to Kikkoro
anime.synopsis: Morizo and Kikkoro are the official mascot characters of EXPO 2004 Aichi, Japan. They are fairies of forest, they teach us the strength and beauty of nature that we tend to forget. The EXPO will be held on Kasho Forest in Seto, where Morizo and Kikkoro, the fairies of forest, are living. Morizo is an old and knowledgeable creature that has been living for thousands years. Kikkoro was a child of forest born little before, and he likes Kikkoro very much He is curious about everything he sees, and his daily lives are full of wonders.

anime.title: Kono Shihai kara no Sotsugyou: Ozaki Yutaka
anime.synopsis: A compilation OVA of 5 stories portrayed on the life of Ozaki Yutaka, a famous Japanese musician in the 80s and early 90s that died young in his career.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Anpanman to Christmas no Hoshi
anime.synopsis: A special Christmas episode.

anime.title: Sky Kids BooBy
anime.synopsis: A heartwarming story of a acrobatic jet-plane, BooBy and his friends climbing up the height of stardom. Currently adopted as a official character of Kansai International Airport. (Source: Tatsunoko Production)

anime.title: Fuichin-san
anime.synopsis: The story is about Fuichin, a young tomboy girl living in Manchuria. Based on Toshiko Ueda's experience.

anime.title: Akuei to Gacchinpo
anime.synopsis: Surreal gag-packed story about a Japanese boy named Takeshi who, after having immense toilet troubles, takes a bathroom break from class and ends up sucked down the toilet into an underwater world. There he meets a spunky girl named Jasmine and is dragged into her organization, UNCO, tasked with fighting the evil PIPS, a group bent on destroying the world. Both Takeshi and Jasmine often use the underwater world to travel into Springtown, Taiwan, to team up with their fellow UNCO member and good friend, Akuei, in order to take down the evil menace or deal with whatever wacky hijinks stand in their way.

anime.title: Ganbare!! Tabuchi-kun!! (ONA)
anime.synopsis: The shorts were animated in Flash and streamed by BBit-Japan, a now-defunct distribution website. The first episode was made available for free, and the following episodes cost 200 yen each.

anime.title: Chiisai Sensuikan ni Koi o Shita Dekasugiru Kujira no Hanashi
anime.synopsis: The third film in Shin-Ei's series of annual WWII themed anime television movies for children "Sensou Douwa" (war story).

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Tokushu Keiji Kaimetsu!? Lemon to Nazo no Touzokudan!
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 318 and 319 of the TV series.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Ryoutsu-ke San-dai, Ougonkyou e no Chindouchuu!
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast between episodes 332 and 333 of the TV series.

anime.title: Ashita Kirarin
anime.synopsis: Ayako suffers from autism, and all kids in the class mock her except for Yuri - the only girl who shows some kindness towards her. Greatly appreciating that, Ayako gives Yuri a present - a beaded bracelet. Later, the school is preparing for the summer cultural festival, and Ayako's present inspires Yuri with an idea to make a decoration for one of the school's exterior walls - a giant picture made of ropes beaded with empty cans of different colours. All kids including Ayako then gather empty cans from all around the city and start creating the picture. However, the day before the festival is scheduled to open a typhoon hits the city, threatening to ruin the kids' hard work.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Tsukiko to Shiratama - Tokimeki Dancing
Sore Ike! Anpanman: Yumeneko no Kuni no Nyanii
Pa-Pa-Pa the ★ Movie: Perman - Tako de Pon! Ashi wa Pon!
anime.synopsis: Dr. Octo who researches octopodes decides to take over the world as he deems the eight legged creatures a more suitable master species than humans. To do this, he takes an idol singer Sumire Hoshino (aka Perman #3) hostage. Mitsuo Suwa (aka Perman #1) likes the idol dearly (as he doesn't know the real identity of his Perman partner) and becomes so angry that he transforms to go rescue her. But fighting a giant octopus is more challenging than it looks! Screened simultaneously with Doraemon Movie 25: Nobita no Wan Nyan Jikuudeni and Doraemon Anniversary 25.

anime.title: Genki Genki Nontan (2004)
anime.synopsis: Direct continuation of the first season. Also labeled as episode 16-25.

anime.title: HAPPY☆LESSON ADVANCE: Bau Bau★Kanna no X'mas Soudou
anime.synopsis: One day, as Christmas approaches, Chitose spots a puppy in town. It turns out to be Chibisuke, the puppy he had rescued and cared for after an accident. Concerned about Chibisuke, Chitose goes to check on him, only to encounter Kanna, who had been searching for Chitose, determined to claim him for herself... (Source: Bandai Channel, translated) Note: An unaired episode included with the 5th DVD volume of the Director's Cut edition of HAPPY☆LESSON ADVANCE, taking place between episodes 8 and 9.

anime.title: Genki Genki Nontan: Utaou! Christmas
anime.synopsis: A Christmas OVA of Non-tan that features eight classic Christmas songs sung and acted out by the characters.

anime.title: GaoGaiGar Special
anime.synopsis: #14.5 - "Valnar of the Sea" - The whale Valnar becoming Zonderised, its up to the 3G team to save it. #43.2 - "Gold Tiger & Silver Puma" - Hyoma and President Taiga become Zonderised, its up to everyone to try and save them using abilities not shown in the TV show.

anime.title: Kotencotenco
anime.synopsis: Kotencotenco is a gag strip anime for young children featuring the flourishes of the Prince of the country of the Paradice, Kotenco. Kotenco guards the “Angel Star” for the Queen in the Paradice. Kotenco is a very good child, but when the bad spirits rise, Kotenco transforms into Matenco. Unlike Kotenco, Matenco is a very naughty child and troubles everyone. But don't worry! By changing the angel ring, Matenco goes back to being Kotenco. Will Kotenco be able to guard the “Angel Star” from the ruler and the Devil of the Country of the Ground, who is aiming for the Paradice?

anime.title: Pozzie
anime.synopsis: An innovative animated series in which the characters are made from water. Pozzie is a child who is created from a drop of water. While encountering various animals and objects, Pozzie continuously metamorphoses into other watery shapes. (Source: BANFF2010.com)

anime.title: Oden-kun
anime.synopsis: In an odd dimensional bubble inside the kettle of an Oden food cart exists Oden village. The residents of Oden village spend their idyllic days waiting for customers to come and eat them. In the meantime, Oden-kun helps other troubled dwellers to realize their dreams. One day, he hears that a customer's mother suffers from cancer so he leaves the kettle and after being eaten, faces the cancer cell Gannosuke. Oden-kun's dream is to meet his own mother. Looking forward to this day, Oden-kun spends his days doing one good deed a day. (Source: Anime News Network)

anime.title: Hurdle
anime.synopsis: Yuuki has to move from Yokohama to a rural city and becomes the target of bullying. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Stag Beetle Tsumami
anime.synopsis: One day, a fashion model fell in love with a human-sized anthropomorphic stag beetle. The two were both married, and they have a strange daughter! Tsumami, the odd couple's only child, is an absolute troublemaker. She is capable of turning others' lives to mistress and likes to cause calamities to the public.

anime.title: Gokiburi-chan
anime.synopsis: A story about love, friendship, and effort that cockroaches and their friends put into living behind a refrigerator in an ordinary salaryman's family home. Cockroaches who are hated by all humans strive every day to be liked by everyone in the family; will the day when they are accepted by the family come?

anime.title: Akuei to Gacchinpo THE MOVIE: Chelsea no Gyakushuu/Akuei to Mahou no Hammer
anime.synopsis: A double release featuring two Akuei movies; Counterattack of Chelsea and Akuei and His Magic Hammer.

anime.title: Kumo no Gakkou
anime.synopsis: Near the end of the 19th century, a young boy loses his father and has to move from a comfortable city to a poor village in Saitama. There, living with his mother, elder sister, and a dog, he learns valuable lessons about what's truly important in life.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Kuroyuki-hime to Mote Mote Baikinman
anime.synopsis: Baikinman is snatched by a black cloud inhabited by a princess who loves black, Kuroyukihime. She is immediately thrilled with him and starts making trouble with him, turning everything black. However, both Dokin-chan and Anpanman are determined to stop her.

anime.title: Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo Special: Ryoutsu VS Nakimushi Idol!? Nihon Isshuu Dai Sugoroku Game!!
anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after the TV series.

anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after the TV series.

anime.title: Wonder Beat Daisakusen: Pilot Film
anime.synopsis: A pilot film for the tenth episode of Wonder Beat S, originally titled Wonder Beat Daisakusen, released with the DVD box of the series.

anime.title: ASTRO BOY: Tetsuwan Atom - 10-man Kounen no Raihousha - IGZA
anime.synopsis: Japan's first fully animated IMAX anime film. Interplanetary spacecraft Galileo II is heading for Saturn's largest moon Titan. However the machines on the moon are trying to destroy humans, so Atom must go and fix the problem.

anime.title: Nepos Napos
anime.synopsis: You see a whale-shaped cloud drifting in the blue sky. What you don't see is a strange land of Nepos Napos that lies above it. Don't you want to know what is happening and how everybody lives up there? (Source: The Answer Studio)

anime.title: Sylvanian Families Mini Gekijou: Omoigakenai Okyakusama
anime.synopsis: A 3DCG anime of Sylvanian Families. The OVA was sold bundled with toy merchandise of the franchise.

anime.title: Sayonara, Midori ga Ike: Tobe! Tako Glider!!
Silk Road Shounen Yuuto
anime.synopsis: When a boy Yuto visits Qinghai in China, he is involved in the battle between time-travelers, and he is sent to the Silk Road in the past. They are looking for a mysterious treasure, the statue of Yuki Daruma Taishi, which is said to make miracles. Seeing historical events and encountering historical persons, such as Yang Guifei and Xuanzang, he will learn many thinks. Whether will he be able to go back to today? (Source: AnimeNfo)

anime.title: RGB Adventure
anime.synopsis: The light – it is the resource of life. There are mysterious monsters and robots that aim at the powers of the light, i.e. R(Red), G(Green), and B(Blue). However, no one notices that… except three children. Ryu - he is a stupid, simple, and mischievous boy who he says without hesitation that his dream is to the conqueror of the world. Guccho - he is a nerd of mechanics, glutton, and chicken-hearted. Becky - she is very cute, but she has a very twisted personality. They have encouraging friends, such as Rosso, Gibson, Bo, etc. They are various aliens that usually change their figures into animals. By exchanges between aliens who have different principles, purposes, tastes, and hobbies, they will learn importance of communications. While it was planned to run for half a year, problems at ACC Production resulted in only six episodes, plus two "extra" & "summary" episodes, actually being aired; five more episodes had scheduled air dates, however. The anime also never saw a DVD release, with only a drama CD seeing release. (Source: AnimeNfo)

anime.title: Furakappa
anime.synopsis: Some sort of educationnal anime for children. A bit of humoristic.

anime.title: Miracle! Mimika
anime.synopsis: Himeno Mimika is a daughter of historical cook family. She goes to a cooking school, Miracle Academy which train cooks all over the world. Vying with rivals, she brings out her gift, and she grows up as a cook. (Source: AnimeNfo)

anime.title: Atagoal - Cat's Magical Forest
anime.synopsis: Today is the Atagoal town carnival. Talking cats and human townsfolk are having a ball. Enjoying the party to the fullest is our hero, Hideyoshi, a big fat cat, who is always involved in any trouble going on in the town.

anime.title: A drop of dew
anime.synopsis: Working since before WW2, UEDA Shoji pierced through amateurism, Then, in his picture world he takes, cuts and rearranges photos through his own sensibility, which takes him to the new media that is Ga-nime, encouraged by his friend the actor SANO Shiro, born in the same prefecture. The pictures used for this exhibition are not only from his most famous “Dune Mode” series, but also of many pre/post-war pictures of his birthplace, streetcars running in Tokyo, and traditional scene of Japan, through which a whole culture appears. Source: Toei-anim.co.jp

anime.title: Tetsuro no Kanata
anime.synopsis: A boy encounters a trace of his lost father on tracks where time comes and goes, at a station where time stops. With the help of a mysterious projectionist, the boy and station master search for the truth of the father's image. (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Norabbits' Minutes
anime.synopsis: Norabbits' Minutes features two young rabbit brothers who live together in the forest and have endearing adventures together... though not without some absurd twists.

anime.title: Ukkari Pénélope
anime.synopsis: Meet Penelope, the absent-minded young koala. Rarely seen without Deudeu – her favourite stuffed rabbit – Penelope likes nothing more than finding another adventure in the most unlikely of places. A simple gust of wind blowing her hat away can lead to Penelope running her own stall atop a tree stump where she trades flowers for apples, and paper planes for acorns. From games of hide and seek with her friends, to playing with the bubbles in the bath or counting sheep during nap time, Penelope’s life is never dull – even if she does wear odd socks when she gets herself dressed in the morning. (Source: Anime-Planet)

anime.title: Chuntian Huahua Zhonghua Bowuguan
anime.synopsis: Featuring McDull going through Chinese cultures with children.

anime.title: Tumulus Gal Coffy
anime.synopsis: The TV adaptation of the ONA series. It aired alongside Himitsu Kessha Taka no Tsume as part of THE FROGMAN SHOW.

anime.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Utaou! Odorou! Minna no Christmas
anime.synopsis: A special Christmas episode.

anime.title: Poka Poka Mori no Rascal
anime.synopsis: Rascal is an energetic racoon, who lives in a secret forest called "The Snag Forest". Although sometimes his mother scolds him when he does mischief, the engaging and kind personality of Rascal always makes him popular in the forest. This series depicts everyday adventures of Rascal, and his cheerful friends such as Rilulu, a cute girl racoon, Rock'n, a skunk who loves to play music, Iggy, a mouse who always eats nuts and a lot more!! (Source: AniDB)

anime.title: Anpanman to Hajime yo! Iro, Kazu, Katachi Wakarukana Iro, Katachi
anime.synopsis: Part of the "Let's start with Anpanman" series of educational animation for kindergarten children featuring characters from Anpanman.

anime.title: Wa Wa Wa Wappi-chan
anime.synopsis: In a land where the past and the future connects, Watto Waapu, the young Wappi-chan encounters situations in which phrases with meanings rooted in the Japanese culture are used. She goes to the past through her dreams through which she learns right Japanese.

anime.title: Patta Potta Monta
anime.synopsis: Three monkey brothers from the from an urban city go to live in the countryside. There's no convenience store nor arcades there; truly bare-bones. The story follows their daily lives trying to make friends and have fun amongst the villagers.

anime.title: Hoshi no Oujisama Petit Prince Specials
anime.synopsis: Unaired episodes 36-39 of Hoshi no Oujisama Petit Prince.

Tama & Friends: Sagase! Mahou no Punipuni Stone
anime.synopsis: A spin-off of Tama & Friends taking place in a fantasy world. Tama, along with his friends Shima and Hat, have to find magic stones accross the universe.

anime.synopsis: Special episode of Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo broadcast after the TV series.
